title: Would anybody be willing to make a Black and White Clone?
author: Dangerous_Three_8506
selftext:
The old game by Peter Molyneux. Not number 2, but number 1.

I would love you so much if you made it and put it on Github for me to play with the code. I would be so happy. Made with Astra of course!

It was my birthday 1 week ago, does that count?

I played that game everyday for years, I also wanted to mod it but it wasn't really feasible at the time.

If this is an inappropriate post just let me know, I apologize in advance. I was told its better to ask forgiveness rather than permission for some things. This is one of them.

What a time to be alive. Video games and Studios being made in the 10000s everyday. Its so awesome.

The studio creation is honest to god the coolest experience. "GPT, lets work with Claude and remake Photoshop and Spine and Blender but for me."

"Lets make scripts for very open-source studio and see what you can do!!!"
